ruth.3.p1.b1.text: My daughter, should I not seek a resting place for you, that it may be well with you?

ruth.3.p1.b2.text: Now is not Boaz, … a relative of ours? In fact, tonight he is winnowing barley on the threshing floor.

ruth.3.p1.b3.text: Therefore wash yourself, put on perfume, and wear your best clothes. Go down to the threshing floor, …

ruth.3.p1.b4.text: I will do everything you say

ruth.3.p2.b1.text: So she went down to the threshing floor and did everything her mother-in-law had instructed her to do.

ruth.3.p2.b2.text: After Boaz had finished eating and drinking and was in good spirits, he went to lie down at the end of the heap of grain.

ruth.3.p2.b3.text: Then Ruth went in secretly, uncovered his feet, and lay down.

ruth.3.p3.b1.text: At midnight, Boaz was startled, turned over, and there lying at his feet was a woman!

ruth.3.p3.b4.text: Spread the corner of your garment over me, for you are a kinsman-redeemer.

ruth.3.p4.b1.text: May the LORD bless you, my daughter. You have shown more kindness now than before, …

ruth.3.p4.b2.text: And now do not be afraid, my daughter. … all my fellow townspeople know that you are a woman of noble character.

ruth.3.p4.b3.text: Yes, it is true that I am a kinsman-redeemer, but there is a redeemer nearer than I.

ruth.3.p4.b4.text: But if he does not want to redeem you, as surely as the LORD lives, I will. …

ruth.3.p5.b1.text: So she lay down at his feet until morning, but she got up before anyone else could recognize her.

ruth.3.p5.b2.text: Do not let it be known that a woman came to the threshing floor.

ruth.3.p5.b3.text: Bring the shawl you are wearing and hold it out.

ruth.3.p5.b4.text: When she did so, he shoveled six measures of barley into her shawl. Then he went into the city.

ruth.3.p6.b1.text: How did it go, my daughter?

ruth.3.p6.b2.text: Then Ruth told her all that Boaz had done for her.

ruth.3.p6.b3.text: He gave me these six measures of barley, for he said, ‘Do not go back to your mother-in-law empty-handed.’

ruth.3.p6.b4.text: Wait, my daughter, … until you find out how things go, for he will not rest unless he has resolved the matter today.
